founders.author: llm
founders.rationale: A shared frame-driven explorer segments visible objects for clicks, learns action effects and colour activity, credits recent actions when levels increase, penalizes unchanged or reset outcomes, and searches its observed transition graph for unexplored actions. Small tensors control action preference, visual salience, learning, and exploration. No game identities or stored solutions are used.

limitations: One seed and founder; no mutations/crossover
Random ablations are not an equally charged random-evolution arm
No matched explorer or joint ARC-1/2/3 model
Expected standard contract/scientific failures; no waiver
